Our difference

The "Uber" of hospital social work

Where classic platforms leave the door open to fraud, we verify identity and genuine need upfront.

Upfront validation

A social worker or certified NGO verifies identity and real need before any publication.

No family access

The fund is administered 100% by the institution. The family never touches the money.

Escrow account

Funds flow through a dedicated account, released via conditional cheques from the banking partner.

Minimal data

No confidential medical data. Strictly limited patient profile, automatic blurring for minors.

Validated appeals

Medical cases and NGO projects verified upfront. Follow progress in real time.

How it works

From genuine need to controlled release

  1. 1

    Institutional validation

    The hospital or NGO creates and certifies the appeal.

  2. 2

    Secure donations

    Mobile Money (Orange, MTN, Wave, Airtel) or bank card for the diaspora.

  3. 3

    Escrow account

    Collected funds are held in a dedicated platform account.

  4. 4

    Release on documents

    Direct payment to the hospital or supplier — never to the family.
